expert.rationale: Level 3 (rubric anchor: Purpose and audience are clear on the entry surface and the main flow reflects the intended feelings, with minor inconsistencies.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Welcome states purpose and audience plainly. The dashboard shows freshness ('Stale', 'Sync delayed') as the copy promises. One contradiction at entry: welcome says it reads OEM telemetry directly, the capabilities page says manufacturer integrations are in development.

Level 2 (rubric anchor: Some deliberate choices are visible but they are not applied consistently across the main screens.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Sand and gold palette and the logo carry identity, but the shell is a dark sidebar with card grids common to admin templates. 13 side-stripe borders in source, 40 nested-card hits when rendered. No DESIGN.md records the identity.

Level 2 (rubric anchor: Main tasks can be completed, but several screens carry unclear actions, long forms or avoidable memory demands.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Dashboard surfaces the dispatch board and alerts early. Mixed signals: 'Active now 2, 100% operational' beside 'No telemetry 2'; Fleet 'Needs attention' lists the same two machines as 'Top performers'. Forms are long (3 over the 8-field bound).

Level 3 (rubric anchor: Spacing, type, states and motion are consistent across screens and breakpoints, with minor roughness.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Spacing, type and states are consistent across 27 rendered pages. Measured: no horizontal overflow at 375, 768 or 1280px on any of them, and a hamburger nav on phones. Reduced motion fully covered. Roughness: 22 skipped headings, 18 pulsing dots.

Level 2 (rubric anchor: Claims and data handling are mostly honest; some states or notices are vague or incomplete.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Good: freshness and sync state shown; seeded alert labelled as fixture; the wiki records unverified integrations. Gap: Integrations labels 16 manufacturers 'Available' though the wiki says none was ever connected; welcome says it reads OEM telemetry directly.

Level 1 (rubric anchor: The main flow is completable but with serious barriers (contrast, labels, focus) in several places.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. No assistive-technology test. 202 form controls sit beside a label with no for/id (sample checked), 20 click handlers sit on non-focusable anchors, the PDF report has no lang, placeholders 3.2-3.8:1, white on red badge 3.8:1, light text on green 1.9:1. Focus rings are present.
